plan.title: Closed RFQ Custom Event Time Extension

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Configure post-expiry surrogate bidding as required.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage named in the case.
Reach the Responses view before opening Settings, matching the case flow.
Select Custom and confirm with no duration, asserting the closed RFQ's response to the invalid or empty extension.
